chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
No one hoards food except a sinner.

key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, the Divine Name of God
key_terms.خَاطِئٌ: a sinner; one acting wrongly and blameworthily
key_terms.رَسُولُ: the Messenger, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.يَحْتَكِرُ: hoards or withholds goods from the market to create scarcity

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about hoarding food?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns the hoarding of food and describes it as the act of a sinner. It reflects the Islamic concern for public welfare, fairness in trade, and preventing harm to the community through artificial scarcity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3959 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said:
"No one hoards food except a sinner."
